artifact_inventory.description: Exact-integer bounded verification of the normal form and fixed-support constructions, with asymptotic spot checks.

limitations: Because the normal form is elementary and old, a fixed-support refinement could exist in recreational or problem literature under terminology not indexed by modern searches.; The result counts triangles rather than distinct perimeter values, and does not study secondary terms.
record_title: Fixed prime support in square-perimeter primitive Pythagorean triangles
scientific_context: Primitive Pythagorean triangles with square perimeter are refined by exact finite odd-prime support and counted asymptotically.
